new_jobs.description:
Responsibilities

About the Team
The TikTok U.S. Data Security (USDS) team is responsible for the security, integrity, and compliance of TikTok’s data within the United States. The Data Platform Team builds a scalable, reliable, cost-efficient infrastructure that ensures data integrity and empowers every business unit to win through self-service tools and scientific insights.

About the Role
We are seeking a Senior Machine Learning Engineer to join our team as a technical lead, driving the architecture and execution of our next-generation AI Risk & Compliance Intelligence Platform and Intelligent Data Agent Ecosystem.
In this role, you will be instrumental in bridging the gap between standard prompt engineering and native, model-driven reasoning frameworks. You will tackle complex ML challenges around offline/online evaluation, synthetic data generation for small-sample scenarios, and automated agent skill optimizations across Data & Engineering workflows (DA/DS/DE/SRE).

Key Responsibilities
- Design, build, and scale robust LLM evaluation architecture, including automated offline datasets, metric suites, and benchmarking pipelines to measure prompt and model performance.
- Innovate on LLM-driven synthetic data generation methodologies to tackle data scarcity bottlenecks and systematically evaluate long-tail/edge-case risk scenarios.
- Advance beyond criteria-based prompt engineering by extracting deep risk patterns directly from complex case data to build native, ML-driven decision models and reasoning abstractions.
- Architect, evaluate, and continuously optimize modular agent skills and tools tailored for Data Science, Analytics, Data Engineering, and SRE workflows to maximize tool-use accuracy, execution efficiency, and task success rates.
- Implement advanced evaluation methodologies (such as LLM-as-a-judge and multi-agent benchmarking) across both risk intelligence and agentic ecosystems.
- Provide technical leadership by establishing core ML system design patterns, benchmarking standards, and engineering best practices, while translating complex operational requirements into scalable machine learning solutions across cross-functional partnerships.

Qualifications

Minimum Qualifications
- Experience: 5+ years of software/ML engineering experience with a strong track record of designing, building, and deploying ML/LLM systems in production.
- Generative AI & LLMs: Deep hands-on expertise with LLM architectures, fine-tuning, RAG, prompt tuning, and agentic frameworks.
- Evaluation & Data Bootstrapping: Demonstrated experience building robust LLM evaluation frameworks (LLM-as-a-judge, automated benchmark pipelines) and tackling data scarcity/imbalance problems.
- Core Engineering: Strong coding skills alongside production experience with scalable data processing pipelines.

Preferred Qualifications
- Prior domain experience in Risk & Compliance Intelligence and Automated Decision Systems.
- Hands-on experience with synthetic dataset generation or bootstrapping models for cold-start scenarios.
- Experience building AI tools or agents for technical personas (Data Analysts, Data Scientists, Data Engineers, Data SRE).
- Demonstrated ability to serve as a founding technical lead on ambiguous, high-impact initiative pods.

About USDS

TikTok USDS Joint Venture LLC is dedicated to the safety and security of millions of Americans who create, discover, and connect with what they love on the apps we operate. The Joint Venture has been established in compliance with the Executive Order signed by President Trump on September 25, 2025. Our foundation is a comprehensive data privacy and cybersecurity program we operate under defined safeguards to protect national security and secure U.S. user data, apps and the algorithm. We safeguard the U.S. content ecosystem, holding decision-making authority for trust and safety policies and moderation. USDS Joint Venture helps ensure Americans can continue to express their creativity, discover new hobbies and interests, and build thriving communities and businesses on a global scale.​
​
On-site presence across teams allows the company to operate with greater speed, alignment, and agility — especially in areas like real-time decision-making, team development, and integrated execution. As such, the company is shifting from a hybrid work model to a fully in-person schedule up to 5 days a week.​

Why Join Us

Inspiring creativity is at the core of TikTok's mission. Our innovative product is built to help people authentically express themselves, discover and connect – and our global, diverse teams make that possible. Together, we create value for our communities, inspire creativity and bring joy - a mission we work towards every day.​
We strive to do great things with great people. We lead with curiosity, humility, and a desire to make impact in a rapidly growing tech company. Every challenge is an opportunity to learn and innovate as one team. We're resilient and embrace challenges as they come. By constantly iterating and fostering an "Always Day 1" mindset, we achieve meaningful breakthroughs for ourselves, our company, and our users. When we create and grow together, the possibilities are limitless. Join us.​
​
Diversity & Inclusion​
TikTok is committed to creating an inclusive space where employees are valued for their skills, experiences, and unique perspectives. Our platform connects people from across the globe and so does our workplace. At TikTok, our mission is to inspire creativity and bring joy. To achieve that goal, we are committed to celebrating our diverse voices and to creating an environment that reflects the many communities we reach. We are passionate about this and hope you are too.​

new_jobs.description:
LinkedIn is the world’s largest professional network, built to create economic opportunity for every member of the global workforce. Our products help people make powerful connections, discover exciting opportunities, build necessary skills, and gain valuable insights every day. We’re also committed to providing transformational opportunities for our own employees by investing in their growth. We aspire to create a culture that’s built on trust, care, inclusion, and fun – where everyone can succeed.​

Join us to transform the way the world works.

Job Description

At LinkedIn, our approach to flexible work is centered on trust and optimized for culture, connection, clarity, and the evolving needs of our business. The work location of this role is hybrid, meaning it will be performed both from home and from a LinkedIn office on select days, as determined by the business needs of the team.

LinkedIn's Data Science team turns member and customer behavior into product decisions across one of the world's largest professional networks. We design experiments, investigate metric movements, and partner with PM and Engineering to ship features that create real economic opportunity for members, including the next generation of AI-powered experiences.

We're hiring a Senior data scientist to own ambiguous, high-impact problems end-to-end. You’ll use your strong statistical intuition and well-honed data science tool kit to answer open-ended problems like defining long-term retention or marketplace value. You’ll define the metrics that guide product strategy, dive deep into marketplaces and evaluate AI-native features as they ship. You'll work closely with engineers and PMs to translate findings into roadmap decisions.

Responsibilities

Designs and performs data-driven experiments and causal analyses to test and validate new product ideas or go-to-market strategies, develop ecosystem understanding, and monitor current products or systems.

Evaluates A/B and causal tooling for discernable gaps and potentially partners with Applied Sciences teams to create A/B and causal test protocols and methods and analyze ramp performance to help optimize new and/or existing features or models.

Leverage AI tools in day-to-day workflows to increase productivity

Partners with internal customers to translate business problems into data-verifiable hypotheses.

Develops and employs models and causal analyses (e.g., panel analysis, A/B testing) to determine what drives metric relationships and create actionable insights within moderately complex product domains.

Independently diagnoses issues and identifies opportunities to drive improvements within AI/LLM systems.

Prototypes data solutions, and/or collaborates with relevant partners (e.g., Data Science teams, Engineering) to operationalize, build, and validate scalable tools/applications/solutions for use by internal customers to convert data into insights.

Embeds data science best practices and principles through all phases of development of customized and/or scalable data solutions, providing feedback to junior team members.

Communicates with relevant partners and internal customers on scoping data-driven investigations and experiments, contributing to recommendations for what best to prioritize to achieve intended strategy.

Develops and runs predictive models for estimating the impact of initiatives on identified KPIs.

Independently creates compelling, data-centric stories based on analytical findings to contribute to internal customers' decision-making.

Qualifications

Basic Qualifications

Bachelor's Degree in a quantitative discipline: Computer Science, Statistics, Operations Research, Informatics, Engineering, Applied Mathematics, Economics, etc.
3+ years of relevant industry or relevant academia experience working with large amounts of data
Experience influencing strategy through data-centric presentations.
Experience in SQL.
Background in at least one programming language (e.g., R, Python, Scala).
Experience in applied statistics and statistical modeling in at least one statistical software package.
Experience telling stories with data and visualization tools.
Experience running platform experiments and techniques like A/B testing.

Preferred Qualifications

Master's Degree or Doctorate in Applied Mathematics, Computer Science, Data Science, Economics, Engineering, Informatics, Statistics, or related field.

Experience with SQL & Python, experimentation (design, analysis, variance reduction),

Experience with causal inference methods;

Product intuition for two-sided marketplaces

Clear written communication

Ability to understand how to measure AI-powered product experiences.

Suggested Skills

Communication

Decision Making

Data Science

Domain Knowledge and Skills

Strategic Thinking

You will Benefit from our Culture

We strongly believe in the well-being of our employees and their families. That is why we offer generous health and wellness programs and time away for employees of all levels. LinkedIn is committed to fair and equitable compensation practices. The pay range for this role is $125,000 to $205,000. Actual compensation packages are based on several factors that are unique to each candidate, including but not limited to skill set, depth of experience, certifications, and specific work location. This may be different in other locations due to differences in the cost of labor.The total compensation package for this position may also include annual performance bonus, stock, benefits and/or other applicable incentive compensation plans. For more information, visit https://careers.linkedin.com/benefits.

Additional Information

new_jobs.title: Technical Lead, AI Platform Architect
new_jobs.description:
Qualifications:

Leadership & Core Experience
Proven Technical Leadership: 8+ years of experience architecting and operating production backend or distributed systems, including at least 2+ years acting as a Technical Lead.
Educational Foundation: Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience.

AI & Architecture Expertise
Production AI Tracking: Hands-on experience successfully deploying LLM-powered applications or agents to production, with a strong understanding of handling edge cases, failures, and mitigation.
Framework & Tooling Engineering: Advanced Python proficiency combined with a track record of designing robust frameworks, developer SDKs, or platform APIs tailored for other engineering teams.

Foundational Engineering & Communication
Distributed Systems Mastery: Deep understanding of distributed system fundamentals, including API design, asynchronous/event-driven processing, data streaming, caching strategies, rate limiting, and fault-tolerant architectures.
Technical Communication: Excellent written communication skills, with proven ability to author comprehensive system design documents that articulate technical trade-offs clearly to both engineering teams and executive leadership.
Technical Capabilities & Domain Expertise:

We are looking for a well-rounded technical leader with broad exposure across these domains and deep expertise in a few key areas:

Agent Orchestration & Interoperability
Agent Development: Architecting tool/function calling, multi-step and multi-agent orchestration, task delegation, durable execution, and human-in-the-loop approval workflows.
Agent Interoperability: Designing open protocols to expose agents and tools seamlessly to other applications and external agents.
AI User Experiences: Engineering streaming agent outputs to web clients and building generative or dynamic user interfaces.
Context Engineering & Lifecycle Management
Context Engineering: Implementing Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), vector/hybrid search, short- and long-term memory systems, automatic summarization, and routing across extensive tool catalogs.
LLM Evaluation & Observability: Building evaluation datasets and rubrics, leveraging LLM-as-a-judge, running regression testing in CI, and establishing distributed tracing, logging, metrics, SLOs, and online production evaluation.
Enterprise Platform, Security & Governance
LLM Infrastructure: Managing cross-provider model routing, token consumption, cost optimization, response caching, and latency reduction.
AI Safety & Governance: Deploying prompt-injection defenses, PII detection/redaction, guardrails, policy engines, and sandboxed code execution environments.
Core & Multi-Tenant Security: Designing authentication/authorization, service-to-service identity, least-privilege access controls, strict tenant isolation, and detailed audit logging.
Cloud-Native Infrastructure: Operating containers, container orchestration, robust CI/CD pipelines, and infrastructure as code (IaC).

Core Tech Stack & Toolkit
Expertise in Python is required. For the rest of the stack, we look for hands-on exposure to most of these technologies:

Languages & Backend Architecture
Languages: Expert-level Python; solid working knowledge of SQL. Java experience is a valuable asset.
Backend APIs & Streaming: High proficiency in FastAPI, asyncio, and Pydantic; practical experience with REST, gRPC, Server-Sent Events (SSE), WebSockets, and event streaming via Kafka or similar.
AI, Agentic Frameworks & Protocols
Agent Frameworks & Protocols: Hands-on experience with LangGraph and LangChain, or comparable frameworks (e.g., OpenAI Agents SDK, Google ADK, Pydantic AI) along with agent protocols like MCP, A2A, and A2UI.
Models, Providers & Gateways: Interfacing with enterprise APIs (OpenAI, Anthropic, Google Gemini, Amazon Bedrock, Azure OpenAI), serving open-weight models via vLLM, and managing LLM gateways like LiteLLM.
Data, Evaluation & Observability
Data & Retrieval Engines: PostgreSQL with pgvector; vector and search engines (OpenSearch, Elasticsearch, Qdrant); Redis; and embedding/reranking models.
Evaluation & Telemetry: OpenTelemetry (including GenAI semantic conventions); LLM tracing/eval platforms (LangSmith, Ragas, DeepEval); and standard metrics stacks (Prometheus, Grafana).
Security, Infrastructure & Frontend
Security & Governance Tools: OAuth 2.0, OIDC, JWT, and workload identities (SPIFFE/SPIRE); policy-as-code (Open Policy Agent, Cedar); secrets management (HashiCorp Vault); and guardrail frameworks (NeMo Guardrails, Llama Guard, Presidio).
Cloud-Native & Sandboxing: Docker, Kubernetes, Helm, and Terraform; experience with at least one major cloud provider (AWS, Azure, GCP); GitHub Actions or Jenkins; and secure sandbox runtimes (gVisor, Firecracker).
Frontend Engineering: React; streaming chat interfaces; and generative UI frameworks or specifications (Vercel AI SDK, A2UI, MCP-UI).
Preferred Qualifications:
Platform Scale & Adoption: Proven experience building internal platforms, developer SDKs, or frameworks that were successfully adopted across multiple engineering teams.
Enterprise AI Experience: Track record of deploying, running, and managing production AI systems tailored for external enterprise customers.
Open Source & Ecosystem Impact: Active contributions to open-source agentic frameworks or emerging agent protocols.

2 years of experience leading a research agenda in sequence, speech, or audio modeling.
Experience with sequence-to-sequence models across state-space or linear attention, token-free latent representations, speech-text modeling, diffusion, flow-matching, speculative decoding, or streaming alignment.
Experience with hardware-aware model co-design, scaling laws, memory or cache optimization, or streaming inference latency in JAX, PyTorch, or TensorFlow.
One or more peer-reviewed publications in machine learning, speech, or audio conferences or journals.

Preferred qualifications:

10 years of experience in the theoretical and algorithmic aspects of sequence modeling and machine learning research.
4 years of experience setting research agendas across multiple projects or teams, and publications in NeurIPS, ICML, ICLR, JMLR, IEEE Transactions, Nature, Interspeech, ICASSP, or ACL.
Experience building, scaling, pre-training, and post-training foundational audio, speech, or multimodal models using reinforcement learning alignment or multi-resolution modeling.
Experience with model compression, distillation, or machine learning acceleration on TPUs or GPUs, and establishing evaluation benchmarks.
Contributions to open-source machine learning or speech toolkits such as JAX, PyTorch, Hugging Face Transformers, Kaldi, K2, or ESPNet.

About The Job

As an organization, Google maintains a portfolio of research projects driven by fundamental research, new product innovation, product contribution and infrastructure goals, while providing individuals and teams the freedom to emphasize specific types of work. As a Research Scientist, you'll setup large-scale tests and deploy promising ideas quickly and broadly, managing deadlines and deliverables while applying the latest theories to develop new and improved products, processes, or technologies. From creating experiments and prototyping implementations to designing new architectures, our research scientists work on real-world problems that span the breadth of computer science, such as machine (and deep) learning, data mining, natural language processing, hardware and software performance analysis, improving compilers for mobile platforms, as well as core search and much more.

As a Research Scientist, you'll also actively contribute to the wider research community by sharing and publishing your findings, with ideas inspired by internal projects as well as from collaborations with research programs at partner universities and technical institutes all over the world.

Google Research is building the next generation of intelligent systems for all Google products. To achieve this, we’re working on projects that utilize the latest computer science techniques developed by skilled software developers and research scientists. Google Research teams collaborate closely with other teams across Google, maintaining the flexibility and versatility required to adapt new projects and foci that meet the demands of the world's fast-paced business needs.

Individual pay is determined by factors including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.

Distributed across 200+ public data centers globally and thousands of private sites at the edge, the SASE-based Zero Trust Exchange is the world’s largest in-line cloud security platform.

We believe the future of work is Human + AI and are building an AI-native enterprise where human potential is amplified by machine intelligence to solve the world’s hardest security challenges. Driven by deep customer obsession, we are committed to the mission, outcome, and to each other. We bring these commitments to life through three core behaviors: ownership and collaboration, trust through outcomes and impact, and a challenge culture with ongoing feedback. Ready to make an impact at the company pioneering security transformation in the AI era? Join us at Zscaler.

Role

We are looking for a Staff Software Engineer - AI Security to join our team. This is a Hybrid role based in San Jose, CA, reporting to the Director, Software Engineering in the Engineering department. We are building security products that enable organizations to adopt AI applications and agents safely and at scale. As a Staff Software Engineer, you will take ownership of complex engineering challenges, build secure and scalable systems, and raise the technical bar through hands-on execution and collaboration.

What You’ll Do (Role Expectations)

Define technical direction and architecture for major areas of the product

You thrive in ambiguity. You build the path as you walk it, viewing ambiguity not as a hindrance but as raw material to create impactful solutions.
You act like an owner. Your passion for the mission fuels your bias for action, seamlessly navigating between high-level strategy and hands-on execution.
You are a problem-solver. You are energized by complex challenges and finding elegant solutions that deliver maximum value.
You are a high-trust collaborator. You build strong relationships through clear feedback, respect, and a commitment to team success.
You are driven by innovation. You possess a deep curiosity for how systems work and are energized by solving technical challenges at the cutting edge of AI security.

What We’re Looking For (Minimum Qualifications)

Demonstrated curiosity and active exploration of AI tools, with a proven history of integrating new technologies to enhance daily workflows and augment problem-solving
5+ years of software-engineering experience, including technical leadership across complex production systems
Strong proficiency in Go, Rust, and Python, with deep expertise in systems engineering, security engineering, and backend platforms

new_jobs.description:
About Entegrata

Entegrata helps law firms turn data into decision-grade insights. Founded in 2023 and headquartered in Indianapolis, we are a venture-backed SaaS company delivering a turnkey, Azure-based data lakehouse platform purpose-built for law firms. Our platform consolidates siloed legal, operational, and financial data into a single governed source of truth, with AI-powered analytics on top. Our mission is to become the data platform of choice for the top law firms in the world.

The Role

Law firms are pouring both time and money into AI, and many efforts stall on the same point: the data underpinning the endeavor. Your job is to fix that.

As our first Applied AI + NLP Engineer, you build the intelligence that turns Entegrata's governed data platform into an enablement layer for a firm's entire AI strategy. You will ship the conversational analytics that let firm leaders interact with their data in plain English and get governed, accurate answers they can act on. In addition to helping unlock value related to structured data from firm systems, you will help us turn legal documents into discrete data. This distillation of documents will help our customers tap into key content with added precision, enabling new insights for customers. You will also build the retrieval and natural-language-to-query capabilities that help firms get more out of the AI tools they already run, and light up new business and practice of law use cases that were not possible before. Because this all sits on top of our governed semantic layer, accuracy, trust, and respect for firm data boundaries are non-negotiable.

This is a senior, hands-on role at the core of our AI enablement roadmap. You will need to be comfortable working where data engineering, AI and product intersect.

Key Responsibilities

AI for Structured Data & Analytics (Initial Focus)

Build systems that translate natural language questions into deterministic analytical workflows and governed queries over structured legal data.
Help define and implement semantic models and metadata that enable LLMs and AI agents to reason consistently over operational, business, and legal data.
Improve intent recognition, query planning, and ambiguity resolution to deliver accurate, consistent responses—even when user requests are incomplete or underspecified.
Develop AI agents capable of accessing, interpreting, and synthesizing structured data and legal content to answer complex business questions.
Build orchestration logic that intelligently selects the appropriate data sources, models, tools, and workflows for each request.
Implement guardrails that ensure AI responses align with governed business definitions, semantic models, and firm conventions.
Build evaluation frameworks, benchmark datasets, and automated tests that continuously improve answer quality, determinism, and reliability.
Collaborate with Data Engineering to expose governed metrics, dimensions, relationships, and business logic for AI consumption.

Document Intelligence & Knowledge Extraction

Design and build AI pipelines that transform complex legal documents into structured, machine-understandable data.
Help design and evolve legal data models that capture the key concepts, relationships, and business meaning contained within legal documents.
Develop techniques to identify legal concepts, obligations, timelines, financial terms, parties, and other domain-specific information that populate and enrich those data models.
Design confidence scoring, validation, and human review workflows that improve extraction quality and support continuous model refinement.

AI Platform Evolution

Optimize AI workflows for quality, latency, scalability, and cost across the platform.
Partner closely with Product, Data Engineering, and legal domain experts to translate customer needs into production AI capabilities.
Stay current with advances in applied AI, LLMs, and agentic systems, bringing practical innovations into production where they create measurable customer value.

What Success Looks Like: 30-60-90 Days

First 30 Days | Learn and Contribute

Ramp on the platform, semantic layer, and current AI capabilities and evaluation approach.
Help create or improve a natural-language query or retrieval flow.

By 60 Days | Build and Improve

Own an end-to-end AI capability, including its evaluation harness and quality metrics.
Deliver the initial design framework for deconstructed legal documents.
Measurably improve answer accuracy or reliability on a defined test set.

By 90 Days | Own and Lead

Deliver production AI features with strong, measured quality and guardrails.
Set a technical direction for a piece of the AI roadmap and drive it forward.
Establish yourself as a trusted technical partner who can independently design, buils and improve AI capabilities across the Entegrata platform.

Required Qualifications

5+ years of software engineering, with hands-on experience building applied AI, NLP, or ML features in production.
Practical experience with LLMs: prompting, retrieval-augmented generation, agents, and tool use.
Experience with information extraction, document parsing, classification or named entity recognition.
Strong evaluation mindset: building test sets and measuring model and system quality.
Solid SQL and understanding of structured data and semantic layers.
Proficiency in Python and one of Go, .NET, or Node.js.
Focus on accuracy, safety, and reliability in customer-facing AI.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience with natural-language-to-SQL or query generation over governed data.
Familiarity with data lakehouse or BI platforms (Databricks, Snowflake, or Microsoft Fabric).
Experience with vector / semantic search, embeddings, reranking and hybrid retrieval.
Experience building pipelines and processing approaches for long-form or highly structured documents.
Legal, finance, or professional services domain exposure.

Technology Stack

Python, LLM tooling, RAG, vector search, SQL, Azure, Go/.NET/Node.js.

Compensation And Benefits

Competitive salary, medical, dental, and vision insurance, 401(k) with employer match, unlimited PTO and company holidays, professional development support, and flexible remote work.

new_jobs.title: Data Scientist
new_jobs.description:
Trillium is a leading proprietary trading firm active in US Equities, US Options, Canadian Equities, and OTC Equities. With trading technology built, tested, and optimized in-house, our engineers and technologists collaborate with our traders to deliver tools and functionality designed to support their needs. Our passion for the markets and our drive to succeed have propelled our track record of growth and profitability for over 20 years. At Trillium, we are a team of problem solvers and independent thinkers dedicated to seizing market opportunities.

We are headquartered in New York City, with additional trading floors in Chicago and Miami. To learn more about Trillium, visit www.trlm.com

The Role

Trillium has traded its own capital for over twenty years. Over that time we’ve built an unusually complete dataset — every trade and every trader’s full history, from first day onward. This role exists to put that data to work: to uncover what it can tell us about trading, risk, and the business, and to build the data science function that will keep doing so.

As our first dedicated Data Scientist
, you’ll own the function from the start: building the models and reporting that answer the firm’s most important questions, and putting results in front of leadership. The first priorities are already defined; over time, we expect you to become a partner in setting new priorities and to open up lines of inquiry we haven’t thought of yet. The problems are concrete. Which early indicators separate traders who go on to sustained success from those who don’t. How to measure and manage risk as we expand into options, futures, and prediction markets. How to forecast headcount and seat demand across three offices. How to make a growing body of unstructured text useful.

You’ll report to our Managing Director of Trading and work directly with traders, technologists, and business leadership. A data engineering partner keeps pipelines and datasets clean and reliable so your time goes to analysis and modeling. There is no analytics organization yet; you’ll help define what it becomes. We’re looking for someone who is rigorous, self-directed, and comfortable being the only expert in the room — and who uses AI tooling as a normal part of how analytical work gets done.

Responsibilities

Build and maintain the dashboards and reporting that leadership, traders, and business teams use to track trading performance, risk, headcount, and firm-level metrics
Lead deep-dive analyses and predictive modeling on the firm’s strategic questions, owning each from framing through delivery
Apply NLP to unstructured text across the business — internal communications, survey and feedback data, and external text sources — building classifiers, extracting themes, and summarizing at scale
Set research priorities directly with leadership and keep them aligned with firm strategy
Work with your data engineering partner to make new datasets fast, clean, and reliable, and with technology and business teams to scope requirements and expand what the firm can measure
Bring automation and forward-looking analysis into the firm’s daily operating rhythm
Make AI and LLM tooling a standard part of the workflow — exploratory analysis, code and query generation, synthesis of unstructured data — and help set how the firm uses these tools responsibly

Requirements

Strong analytical judgment: able to frame an ambiguous problem, choose an appropriate method, validate the result, and state clearly what a conclusion does and does not support
Master’s degree or higher in Data Science, Statistics, Economics, Mathematics, Computer Science, or a related field, or equivalent demonstrated experience
4+ years in data science, analytics, or business intelligence, including independent ownership of modeling work end to end
Strong Python (required) for analysis, statistical modeling, and visualization
Proficiency with SQL (e.g., PostgreSQL, MySQL) for querying and manipulating data
Hands-on experience (required) applying NLP and LLM-based methods to unstructured text at scale, including evaluating output quality and judging which approach fits a given problem
Experience building dashboards in tools such as Tableau, Power BI, Streamlit, or Shiny
Strong command of metrics design, hypothesis testing, statistical inference, and predictive modeling, with a record of turning models into outputs people act on
Clear communicator, able to translate complex analysis into plain business terms for traders and executives
Self-sufficient and curious. As Trillium’s sole data scientist, you’ll drive your own research and resolve hard problems without an internal expert to lean on. Rigorous but unconventional backgrounds are welcome

Location
: This is a hybrid role based in NYC

Compensation and Perks

The reasonably estimated salary for this role is $150,000 - $225,000 + additional bonus if applicable. Actual compensation is based on a number of factors including but not limited to the candidate’s skills, qualifications, and experience.
Comprehensive benefits including PTO, medical and dental insurance, 401(k) matching, parental leave, and pre-tax commuter benefits
Complimentary breakfast on Tuesdays, lunch on Wednesdays and Thursdays
A collaborative culture built on mutual respect and a shared commitment to excellence. Many of our team members have spent their entire careers here, drawn by an environment that values long-term growth and gives people room to build

new_jobs.title: Sr. DevOps Engineer II, AI Platforms
new_jobs.description:
Who We Are

DV is the leader in digital performance solutions, helping our advertiser and agency partners Verify the quality of their digital campaigns, Optimise to improve performance and Prove that they’re achieving their business outcomes, through unbiased 3rd party data and analytics. DV’s mission is to be the definitive source of transparency and data-driven insights into the quality and effectiveness of digital advertising for the world’s largest brands, agencies, publishers, and digital ad platforms. Since 2008, DV has helped hundreds of Fortune 500 companies gain the most from their media spend by delivering best-in-class solutions across the digital advertising ecosystem, helping to build a better industry. Learn more at www.doubleverify.com.

About The Role

Over the past year, DV built an AI platform at speed. More than 800 people now use Claude and Cursor daily against an MCP gateway that fronts 30+ internal tool backends, a gateway for model traffic, a registry where engineers publish skills and plugins, and a tracing pipeline running off every laptop. It was built by a strong, opinionated group of engineers who continue to drive it forward, and it is already in wide production use.

This is the first role at DV dedicated entirely to that platform. You'll join the engineers building it today with AI infrastructure as your full focus, which means having the time to go deep on the hardest problems and keep the platform moving day to day.

A lot of it is already live and needs operating and hardening. Plenty is still ahead of us: group-based authorization across the gateway, a consolidated multi-region model gateway with real failover, and cost attribution that teams can act on.

What You Will Do

Run and harden the MCP gateway day to day. It runs on Envoy Gateway on GKE, secured by Keycloak, serving 30+ backends to Claude Code, Cursor and Claude Desktop across the company, plus an externally reachable gateway. You'll be one of the first responders when it breaks.
Take the lead on closing the authorization gap: group-based access from JWT claims, per-tool RBAC, and scoped OAuth consent in place of the static user lists and broad scopes we run on today.
Help consolidate the model gateway estate onto one supported deployment and drive it to GA, with multi-region, health-checked failover and coverage beyond a single client.
Push AI observability to GA with the team. Finish the trace pipeline, extend it across tools, and give teams per-session, per-user and per-department cost and latency numbers they can trust.
Build out the infrastructure behind AI cost governance: spend caps that reflect real dollars rather than raw tokens, plus attribution, enforcement and alerting.
Support the registry, eval and marketplace platform that lets engineers publish and consume skills, plugins and MCP servers safely, and partner with Security on model and data access control, prompt injection exposure and connector supply chain review.
Work across a DevOps org spread over three regions, pairing with the engineers who built each piece.

Who You Are

Required Qualifications

5+ years in DevOps, Platform Engineering or SRE, with production Kubernetes ownership and the software engineering habits to go with it.
Hands-on experience managing and scaling AI infrastructure in production: Demonstrated track record operating developer AI tools, model routing/gateway platforms, or LLM observability stacks at organizational scale.
Real depth in OAuth 2.0/2.1, OIDC and JWT: token exchange, scope design, claim propagation, and federation between an IdP, an authorization server and a proxy. Some of the hardest problems on this platform live here.
Production experience with a gateway, proxy or service mesh (Envoy or equivalent), and the judgment to debug a misbehaving control plane under pressure.
A track record of taking infrastructure from prototype to GA. You've set the SLOs, built the failover, written the runbooks and carried the pager.
The collaboration skills to work well inside an opinionated, distributed engineering group. You build on other people's work, disagree constructively, and write things down.

Preferred Qualifications

Upstream contributions to Envoy Gateway or a comparable open-source proxy.
LLM observability tooling (Langfuse, LangSmith, Arize Phoenix) and OTEL GenAI conventions.
Cost attribution or chargeback for a shared platform.
Keycloak or equivalent IdP engineering.
Zero-trust access platforms and secrets management.

Our Stack

GCP/GKE, Envoy Gateway, Keycloak, Okta, Terraform, ArgoCD, Helm, Vault, Kafka, Redis, Prometheus/Grafana/Alloy, Langfuse, LangSmith, GitLab CI, Python and Go.

This position is full-time and located in our New York City headquarters offices offering a hybrid work model from office and remote.

The successful candidate’s starting salary will be determined by a number of non-discriminatory factors, including qualifications for the role, level, skills, experience, location, and internal equity relative to peers at DV.

The estimated salary range for this role, based on the qualifications set forth in the job description, is between $153,000 $260,000. This role will also be eligible for bonus/commission (as applicable), equity, and benefits.

The range above is for the expectations as laid out in the job description; however, we are often open to a wide variety of profiles and recognize that the person we hire may be more or less experienced than this job description as posted.

Research shows that while men apply to jobs when they meet an average of 60% of job criteria, women and other marginalized groups tend to only apply when they check every box. So if you think you have what it takes but you’re not sure that you check every box, apply anyway!

new_jobs.title: Applied AI Engineer
new_jobs.description:
About Slang AI

Slang AI is redefining customer engagement through conversational AI, making every interaction seamless and efficient. Our mission is to transform the restaurant industry by providing the ultimate voice AI solution for consistently outstanding customer experiences.

At Slang AI, we believe how we build matters just as much as what we build. We foster a culture rooted in hospitality, ownership, and clarity, where every “Slangsta” feels valued, supported, and connected to the broader impact of our work in the AI-powered future of restaurants.

What Your Experience Will Be

You'll join Slang's Engineering team as our Applied AI Engineer, the person who turns foundation models into products that restaurants trust with their phones. This is not a research or model-training role. You'll work with hosted frontier models and open-weight alternatives, and our own stack to solve real product problems: choosing the right model for each job, designing prompt architectures that hold up across model versions, wiring up agents and tool calls, and proving with evaluation that every change makes the product better before it reaches a guest. When a caller asks for a table for four on Friday at 7, you're the reason the AI gets the date right, sounds like a great host, and knows when to hand off to a human.

You'll lead the work to put model calls behind clean interfaces, redesign prompts so they travel across providers, and build the evaluation and A/B testing machinery that lets us swap models with confidence instead of hope. You'll own this loop end to end: prototype, eval design, rollout, production monitoring, and the post-launch question of "is it actually working for restaurants?" You'll partner closely with backend and platform engineers, product managers, and conversation designers across our delivery pods, and you'll set the technical direction for applied AI across the team.

You'll report to our VP of Engineering, a leader with deep experience across engineering and product who cares about craft, directness, and shipping work that matters. Our stack runs on Google Cloud Platform and spans multiple languages; we pick the right tool for the job and don't require experience in any specific one. You'll join key ceremonies including daily standup at 1:00 PM ET, bi-weekly cycle planning, and weekly Show & Tell. The role is hybrid from New York City (3 days a week in our NYC office), working alongside a distributed team across the US and Brazil.

Why You Belong Here and How You Will Grow

We're AI Native: we don't just sell AI, we run on it. That means your work isn't a side experiment bolted onto a product; it's the product. Our engineering culture values pragmatic solutions, low ego, and quality as a form of respect for whoever builds on your work next. We test before we ship, we ask "why" before we commit, and we'd rather finish a few meaningful things than start many. You'll find teammates who share what they learn in Show & Tell and written design docs, and who treat a hard question from a colleague as a gift, not a threat (Humility Ability is a real value here).

You'll belong here if you get excited about the gap between a great demo and a great production system: latency budgets measured in milliseconds, evals that catch the regression nobody noticed, and a prompt change that quietly lifts booking accuracy across thousands of calls. Because we Build for Hospitality, you'll spend time listening to real calls and learning how restaurants actually run, so your technical judgment is grounded in the guest's experience.

At L5 you'll grow toward staff-level impact: setting applied AI standards that other engineers build within, influencing product strategy with what the models make newly possible, and mentoring engineers who are ramping into AI work. You'll help decide whether and when to fine-tune, self-host, or build more of our own AI capability, and you'll be the person we trust to make that call well.

What Success Looks Like

You will design and ship a provider-agnostic model interface for our voice and text AI, so we can run the same product on different models without rewriting prompts or business logic.
You will build an automated evaluation pipeline (offline eval sets, scenarios, production metrics) that every model and prompt change runs through before it ships, and that the rest of the team can use without you.
You will run model and prompt experiments in production with clear success metrics (booking accuracy, containment, transfer rate, caller hang-ups, latency, cost) and make recommendations the team can act on.
You will measurably reduce AI errors that matter most to restaurants, by moving critical facts into deterministic tools and guardrails rather than model memory.
You will own the latency and cost profile of our AI stack, and bring a clear point of view on when to use frontier APIs, faster inference providers, or open-weight models.
You will set the technical standards for prompt architecture, agent design, and AI observability, and document them so engineers across pods can build on them.
You will level up the team: mentoring engineers ramping into applied AI and bringing relevant developments in the AI tooling landscape back to Slang, with a point of view on what's worth adopting.

What You Will Bring

Required

7+ years of professional software engineering experience, including 2+ years building and operating LLM-powered applications in production (OpenAI, Gemini, Anthropic, or open-weight models).
A track record of technical leadership at the Lead / Tech Lead level: making design decisions with long-term implications, guiding implementation across a system, and mentoring senior engineers.
Deep, hands-on prompt engineering and agent design experience: structured outputs, tool/function calling, multi-step agents, and prompt designs that survive model upgrades. Familiarity with frameworks like DSPy, LangGraph, or similar agent frameworks is a plus; strong fundamentals matter more than any one framework.
Experience designing AI evaluation systems: building eval datasets, choosing between deterministic checks and LLM-as-judge, running A/B tests, and using eval or observability platforms such as Braintrust, Cekura, or similar.
Experience working across multiple model providers and abstracting them behind clean interfaces (for example with LiteLLM, OpenRouter, or your own routing layer), with sound judgment on latency, cost, and quality trade-offs.
Understanding of real-time voice AI architectures: how ASR, LLM, and TTS components fit together, and how speech-to-speech models change the picture.
Strong programming skills in at least one backend language, and comfort ramping quickly into others.
AI fluency: you actively use AI tools in your daily engineering work (coding assistants, agents, AI-assisted review and testing), with clear judgment on when to lean on them and how to validate their output.

Production experience with speech-to-speech or real-time voice frameworks.
Experience with streaming ASR/TTS providers or open-source models.

Fine-tuning experience on foundation models for domain-specific tasks.
GCP experience, particularly Cloud Run and Vertex AI.
Conversational design experience with platforms like Dialogflow CX, or interest in the restaurant and hospitality domain.

How Work Affects My Life

This role puts you at the center of how Slang's AI behaves on every call, with the autonomy to set direction and the support of a team that wants you to succeed.

Hybrid work from New York City: 3 days a week in our NYC office, plus 25 flex remote days a year, with occasional travel to company offsites
Competitive salary and equity package reflecting your expertise and contributions
Comprehensive benefits including health, dental, and vision insurance
Professional development opportunities to enhance your skills and career trajectory
Contribute to a company mission that transforms the restaurant and hospitality industry
Participation in the engineering on-call rotation (a week-long shift roughly every two months)

You'll come away seeing AI the way the best operators see hospitality: the magic is in the details nobody notices when they're done right.

Compensation & Location

The base salary range for this role in New York City is $217,000 to $242,000. Total compensation also includes equity.

Compensation for this role is location-based and benchmarked against local market data aligned to the employee’s primary work location. Total compensation includes a mix of cash and equity and may vary by location, role level, and experience. Our range is therefore wide and not meant as a negotiation range.

Our Vision

Calling a business shouldn’t feel like a robot-hostage situation, where you’re forced to listen to horrible music and can't reach a human, while enduring a soulless voice uttering "I'm sorry I didn't quite get that" on repeat for eternity. (shudder) That’s why we started Slang AI We use the latest AI and audio wizardry to make transacting via voice so enjoyable it’s more human than human. By 2030, we will save businesses and consumers 1 billion minutes of precious time while transforming voice channels into the preferred mode of communication (it's faster and easier than text).

We have backgrounds building product at companies like Spotify, Buzzfeed, the New York Times, and OpenTable —shipping experiences that have reached hundreds of millions of users. Now, we’re using our backgrounds to start a new culture, one that puts product and human-centered design above all else while fostering constant learning and growth. Sound like something you’d like to be part of? Get on board.

Our Values

AI Native. We don't just sell AI. We are Al.

Humility Ability. We approach each other with curiosity and openness (know-it-alls not welcome!)

Slang AI uses AI tools to help review applications, and a person makes every hiring decision. No one is rejected by AI alone: a member of our team reviews your actual application before any decision. Remote | United States | Project-Based Independent Contractor

Compensation: $20-$50 USD/hour, based on specialty, experience, and project requirements

Help Shape the Future of AI in Pharmaceutical

What if your expertise in pharmaceutical development, formulation science, process development, and technical operations could help artificial intelligence better understand how pharmaceutical products are developed, optimized, scaled, and commercialized?

At Volga Partners
, we're connecting experienced pharmaceutical professionals with opportunities to contribute to the development and evaluation of advanced AI models.

We're seeking experienced CMC Scientists and Technical Development professionals
who can apply their scientific expertise, technical judgment, and industry knowledge to evaluate AI-generated pharmaceutical content.

This isn't a traditional pharmaceutical development position. You won't be developing formulations, conducting laboratory research, overseeing technology transfers, or supporting commercial manufacturing operations. Instead, you'll evaluate complex scientific and technical content, identify inaccuracies, assess scientific reasoning, and provide structured feedback that improves AI model performance.

Your pharmaceutical expertise is what matters. AI experience is a plus, not a requirement.

Important Note:
This is a freelance, task-based role designed for those seeking supplemental income. It’s essential to understand the nature of freelance work—tasks will be assigned as they become available, and work may be irregular or intermittent.

The Opportunity

As a CMC Scientist / Technical Development Subject Matter Expert (SME)
, you'll serve as a subject matter evaluator, helping assess the quality, accuracy, completeness, and scientific validity of Pharmaceutical AI-generated content.

You'll analyze scientific, formulation, manufacturing, development, and technical operations scenarios, identify errors or unsupported conclusions, and provide expert feedback grounded in pharmaceutical science, development principles, and industry best practices.

Your contributions will help improve how AI systems understand and respond to complex pharmaceutical development and manufacturing challenges.

What You'll Do

Evaluate AI-generated pharmaceutical content: Assess scientific, technical, and development-focused responses for accuracy, completeness, consistency, and alignment with industry standards.
Review pharmaceutical development information: Examine content related to formulation development, process development, manufacturing science, technology transfer, scale-up activities, and commercialization.
Analyze scientific reasoning: Determine whether AI-generated conclusions are supported by pharmaceutical sciences, engineering principles, development methodologies, and industry best practices.
Identify errors and inconsistencies: Recognize unsupported claims, technical inaccuracies, flawed development approaches, and missing scientific context.
Validate information: Reference applicable FDA requirements, ICH guidelines, pharmaceutics principles, and accepted pharmaceutical development practices.
Provide expert feedback: Clearly explain findings, identify opportunities for improvement, and recommend technically accurate corrections.
Support AI quality improvement: Apply project-specific evaluation criteria, scoring guidelines, and quality standards.
Complete independent evaluations: Use designated online platforms to complete assignments accurately and within established project timelines.

Why Join Volga Partners?

Apply Your Industry Expertise in a New Way

Lead initiatives to educate and train cross-functional teams - including workshops, training sessions, and educational materials - on experimentation design, statistical methodology, and causal inference.

Strong passion for education, with a track record of communicating complex statistical and experimental design concepts to technical and non-technical audiences and fostering a culture of data literacy.

Interest in conducting literature reviews, translating and championing best scientific practices across the company.
Track record using causal inference methods that translated into business decisions and outcomes.
Experience autonomously leading cross-functional projects and influencing cross-functional partners.
